building.name: 55 Second
building.architect: Heller Manus Architects (design architect) with HKS Architects (associate architect)

public_open_space.name: 55 Second St - A
public_open_space.location: Located inside the historic building, up a set of 3-4 steps. Can be accessed through the main lobby (walk past the elevator bay) and through entrances from Jessie and Stevenson Streets.
public_open_space.description: This large, indoor "park" located inside the historia building has a wooden floor, tables with chairs, and large, comfortable leather chairs on a carpeted section near the large window looking out on Stevenson Street.
public_open_space.landscaping: Increase in potted plant number and variety
public_open_space.restrooms: Located in hallway between lobby and indoor park
public_open_space.signage: Yes, at all three building entrances

public_open_space.name: 55 Second St - B
public_open_space.location: The urban garden is at the end of Anthony street, at the Jessie Street entrance to the building
public_open_space.description: This space is located outside the rear entry of 55 Second Street. It has planter boxes that serve as seating throughout the plaza.
public_open_space.landscaping: Plants and trees, uses plant wall to shield users from underground parking entrance
public_open_space.seating: Movable furniture removed; only ~100 ft. of planter ledge seating
public_open_space.restrooms: Located on south side of building
public_open_space.signage: Yes, embedded within concrete bench next to Jessie Street entrance to historic building

public_open_space.name: 55 Second St - C
public_open_space.landscaping: A few planters, interesting paving, Art on walls.
public_open_space.seating: 4 benches (8 seats) along walls of gallery space.
public_open_space.restrooms: Yes, through main lobby at reception desk (ID required)

public_art.title: Waterfall Series
public_art.access: open space and artwork are accessible from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
public_art.detail: Goode, the painter of the Waterfall Series, was born March 23, 1937, in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and is American.
